node.statement: THE SHARED CENSUS KERNEL (named 2026-07-07, correspondence campaign + F5 program P7): the anti-concentration census family at generated-field sub-balance windows (|B0|^t >= 2^n, beta-normalized per catches #11-13) — Q-CLASS: prefix/quotient max-fiber <= mean * poly(n); BC-CLASS: split-in-subspace / split-pencil counts <= max(1, mean, M_B floors) * poly(n); F2-CLASS: non-coset t-null extras <= n^3.
